content: Type 5 Diabetes, as classified by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), includes a Stage 2 that is defined by specific glucose abnormalities. In this stage, fasting plasma glucose levels range between 100 and 125 mg/dL (5.6 to 6.9 mmol/L).8 to 11.0 mmol/L). Hemoglobin A1C levels in this stage are observed to be within the range of 5.7% to 6.4%. These parameters indicate an intermediate degree of impaired glucose tolerance.
